title: Unpopular Opinion
trend: TikTok 'Unpopular opinion' (state a mild arguable take plus one reason; Peaking, top 6.1M views, newest examples Nov 22 2026, Postdom TikTok trends Nov 23 2026, US) + Thanksgiving in two days — two-host table talk show: cousins Ruthie and Carlos play a game where whoever says a popular opinion has to host Thanksgiving next year, and every 'unpopular' take turns out to be loved; the guest, a can of cranberry sauce, judges; twist: the can's own opinion, 'hosting Thanksgiving is fun', is the only unpopular one in America, so the can must host; button: Thanksgiving next year is in the pantry — bring chairs
youtube_title: Say one popular opinion and you have to host Thanksgiving next year 🥧
description:
Ruthie and Carlos have one rule: say a popular opinion and you host Thanksgiving next year. Nobody wants to host. The cranberry sauce is the judge, and it has opinions too.

#cartoon #animation #funny #thanksgiving #shorts
tiktok_caption: unpopular opinion: thanksgiving edition. loser hosts next year 🥧 #cartoon #animation #funny #thanksgiving

lines.text: Welcome back to unpopular opinion, Thanksgiving edition. I am Ruthie.
I am Carlos. And today, whoever says a popular opinion has to host Thanksgiving next year.
Forty relatives. One bathroom. Uncle Frankie.
I am the cranberry sauce. I am the judge. I still have the ridges.
Okay. Unpopular opinion. Cold pie for breakfast is the best meal of the year.
Everybody agrees with that. Everybody in America. Popular.
No! My grandma eats it in the fridge light. I thought that was rare.
My turn. Unpopular opinion. The kids' table is better than the grown up table.
The kids' table has no rules and unlimited rolls. Popular.
I am thirty four. I still sit there. I thought I was brave.
Bigger. Turkey is the least exciting part of Thanksgiving.
Turkey is a large dry bird that everyone pretends about. Popular.
Okay. Stuffing should be made in a waffle maker.
Oh, that is good. I would eat that.
Crispy stuffing squares. Very popular. Ruthie, you are in danger.
I will say something nobody likes. Socks with sandals at dinner.
Uncle Frankie has done it for thirty years. Popular.
That is because Uncle Frankie is scary.
Unpopular opinion. The parade is better than the big game.
That is a real fight. Half the house will leave.
The other half is asleep by the third balloon. Tie.
A tie does not count. Somebody has to host.
Unpopular opinion. Leftovers are better than the actual dinner.
Carlos. That is the most popular sentence in human history.
I panicked. I am sweating gravy.
So that is three for you, three for me. Sudden death.
Mashed potatoes should be lumpy. On purpose. Like a little adventure.
Some people agree. Grandmas mostly. Popular with grandmas.
The best part of the day is when everybody finally goes home.
Every host in America just nodded. Popular.
So we both lose. We both have to host?
Wait. Judge. You have not said an opinion. Everybody plays.
Judges do not play. Judges sit in a bowl and judge.
One opinion. Or you go back in the can.
Fine. Unpopular opinion.
Hosting Thanksgiving is fun.
What?
Nobody thinks that. Not even the people who host.
I mean it. The chaos. The one bathroom. I love a crowd.
That is the most unpopular opinion ever said at this table.
So nobody agrees with you. You win. You do not have to host.
I want to host. That is my prize.
So the cranberry sauce hosts Thanksgiving next year?
I accept. I have waited in the pantry for this since August.
Where do you even live?
Second shelf. Behind the soup. The peaches are very welcoming.
Forty relatives in a pantry.
Uncle Frankie can sit on the rice.
Last opinion of the show. I am excited for next Thanksgiving.
Popular. Everybody wants to see the pantry.
Thanksgiving next year, at my place. Bring chairs. Bring a can opener.
